latest_substantive_result.summary: The v2 correction rejects v1’s ideal parallel-pin resistance equality. For the stated four-subpellet geometry with fixed total pin volume, the corrected ideal parallel axial resistance ratio is H^2=2.12316017. Under the stated additive radial/axial time model, speed requires alpha>0.65722368 for p=1 or alpha>0.57551111 for p=2; alpha is unknown, and an axial-dominated case predicts a 2.12316x slowdown. Both v2 scripts exited 0 on a disposable copy, with all scientific/result fields matching their source outputs after excluding timing and peak RSS. No electrochemical rate, measured metallic-iron gain, or practical advantage is established.
